tools.description: Add a Constant Throughput Timer under the given parent, pacing requests to hit a target rate rather than a fixed per-sample delay.

tools.description: Add an HTTP Cookie Manager under the given parent (usually a Thread Group), so samplers in scope share cookies automatically.

Each thread reads one row per iteration, exposing each column as a JMeter variable. The filename must be an absolute path readable on the machine that will run the test (submit_console_task runs JMeter from a fresh per-execution directory, so relative paths won't resolve).

filename.description: Absolute path to the CSV file

ignoreFirstLine.description: Set true if the CSV's first line is a header row

recycle.description: Start over from the first line once the last row is used

stopThread.description: Stop the thread once the file is exhausted (instead of recycling)

variableNames.description: Comma-separated column names, e.g. 'username,password'. Omit if the CSV has a header row.

tools.description: Add a Duration Assertion under an HTTP sampler, failing the sample if it takes longer than maxDurationMs.

localFilename.description: Local file path, for download destination or upload source

tools.description: Add an HTTP Header Manager under an HTTP sampler (or a Thread Group, to apply to every sampler in it).

tools.description: Add HTTP Request Defaults under the given parent (usually a Thread Group or TestPlan root). Any field left blank on a later add_http_sampler call under the same scope falls back to these values.

tools.description: Add an HTTP Request sampler under the given parent node (usually a Thread Group). To inherit protocol, domain or port from an HTTP Request Defaults config element in scope (add_http_request_defaults), leave that argument out of the call - do not pass an empty string or a placeholder, because those fields have no default of their own. Passing an explicit value always overrides the Defaults for that field.

bodyJson.description: Raw JSON request body, if any

domain.description: Host name, e.g. api.example.com. Omit to inherit from HTTP Request Defaults

port.description: Omit to inherit from HTTP Request Defaults

protocol.description: Omit to inherit from HTTP Request Defaults

tools.name: add_http_sampler

tools.description: Add an If Controller under the given parent (usually a Thread Group). Samplers added under it (as its children) only run when the condition evaluates truthy. condition is evaluated as a real JavaScript (Rhino) expression after JMeter substitutes any ${var} references, so comparisons work directly, e.g. '${count} < 10' or '"${status}" == "ok"'.

condition.description: JavaScript boolean expression evaluated after ${var} substitution, e.g. '${count} < 10'

evaluateAll.description: Evaluate the condition for every iteration, not just the first

tools.name: add_if_controller

tools.description: Add an Interleave Controller under the given parent (usually a Thread Group). Runs one child (added under it) per pass, alternating through them in order instead of running them all.

tools.description: Add a JDBC Connection Configuration (pooled datasource) under the given parent, usually the Thread Group or TestPlan root. A JDBC Request references this element's dataSource name.

dataSource.description: Pool name that JDBC Request samplers will reference

tools.description: Add a JDBC Request sampler under the given parent (usually a Thread Group). dataSource must match a JDBC Connection Configuration's dataSource name added elsewhere in the same plan.

resultVariable.description: Variable name to store the whole result set under

variableNames.description: Comma-separated variable names to store each result column under

tools.description: Add a JSON Assertion under an HTTP sampler, to validate a JSONPath expression exists (and optionally matches a value) in the response.

jsonValidation.description: Whether to check expectedValue at all

tools.description: Add a JSR223 PostProcessor under an HTTP sampler (or a Thread Group, to apply to every sampler in it), running a script after the sample. Scripts default to Groovy, which only works when JMeter runs on a compatible Java (17 is the safe choice; the Groovy bundled with JMeter 5.6.x fails on very new Java such as 25+, killing each virtual user on its first script run) - the result carries a "warning" field when this server detects a mismatch. For unique or random data, prefer the built-in functions ${__UUID}, ${__RandomString} and ${__Random}, which need no script at all.
tools.name: add_jsr223_postprocessor

tools.description: Add a JSR223 PreProcessor under an HTTP sampler (or a Thread Group, to apply to every sampler in it), running a script before the sample. tools.description: Add a JSR223 Sampler under the given parent (usually a Thread Group), running a script as the sample itself. tools.description: Add a Regular Expression Extractor under an HTTP sampler, to save a value from its response (body, headers, etc.) into a variable using a regex capture group. Use this instead of add_json_extractor for non-JSON (HTML/XML/plain-text) responses.

defaultValue.description: Value to use if the regex doesn't match

matchNumber.description: Which match to use (1 = first); 0 = random match; negative = all matches

parentId.description: Id of the HTTP sampler node this extractor applies to

template.description: Which capture group(s) to store, e.g. '$1$'

tools.description: Add a Response Assertion under an HTTP sampler, to fail the sample if the response doesn't match.

not.description: Negate the match (assert the pattern does NOT match)

tools.description: Add a setUp Thread Group under the TestPlan root. Runs once, before all normal Thread Groups start, regardless of where it sits in the tree - typically used for one-time setup (e.g. login, seeding data).

delaySeconds.description: Startup delay: seconds to wait before this thread group starts (enables the scheduler). Use it to stage thread groups, e.g. a second group that begins 5s after the first.

durationSeconds.description: If set, run on a scheduler for this many seconds instead of a fixed loop count

loops.description: Number of loop iterations per thread, -1 for infinite

tools.description: Add a tearDown Thread Group under the TestPlan root. Runs once, after all normal Thread Groups finish, regardless of where it sits in the tree - typically used for one-time cleanup.

delaySeconds.description: Startup delay: seconds to wait before this thread group starts (enables the scheduler). Use it to stage thread groups, e.g. a second group that begins 5s after the first.

durationSeconds.description: If set, run on a scheduler for this many seconds instead of a fixed loop count

loops.description: Number of loop iterations per thread, -1 for infinite

tools.name: add_teardown_thread_group

tools.description: Add a Thread Group (virtual users) under the given parent node (usually the TestPlan root).

delaySeconds.description: Startup delay: seconds to wait before this thread group starts (enables the scheduler). Use it to stage thread groups, e.g. a second group that begins 5s after the first.

durationSeconds.description: If set, run on a scheduler for this many seconds instead of a fixed loop count

loops.description: Number of loop iterations per thread, -1 for infinite

parentId.description: Id of the node to attach this thread group under

rampTimeSeconds.description: Seconds to reach full thread count

tools.description: Add a Transaction Controller under the given parent (usually a Thread Group). Samplers added under it (as its children) are timed and reported as a single named transaction instead of separately.

name.description: Name of the transaction, e.g. 'Checkout Flow'

tools.description: Add a Uniform Random Timer under the given parent to pace requests with a randomized delay: delayMs +/- a random amount up to rangeMs, picked fresh before each sample.

tools.description: Add a User Defined Variables config element under the given parent (TestPlan root for global variables, or a Thread Group to scope them there). Values are set once, before the test starts.

tools.description: Add a While Controller under the given parent (usually a Thread Group). Samplers added under it (as its children) repeat while condition holds. tools.description: Add an XPath Extractor under an HTTP sampler, to save a value from an XML/HTML response into a variable using an XPath expression. Set tolerant=true for real-world (non-strict) HTML.

referenceName.description: JMeter variable name to store the extracted value in

tools.description: 分页读取报告已保存的接口/采样标签统计。nodeId可选，省略仅全局汇总；stepKey可选；支持failedOnly及latency、failure_rate、failures排序，失败率是采样比例。

value.description: 固定文本，或完整随机规则 {{$random.uuid}}、{{$random.hex(N)}}、{{$random.alnum(N)}}、{{$random.digits(N)}}（N为1至256且无前导零），或自动规则 {{$auto.client_ip}}、{{$auto.timestamp_ms}}。变量名任意；client_ip取本次调用的实际HTTP来源IP，不信任XFF，来源不可用时报错；timestamp_ms为当前毫秒时间戳字符串。规则原文保存，合并后每次连接/调试/任务快照解析一次，同次操作共享、任务重试复用冻结快照；禁止嵌入文本、脚本和其他规则语法，逐线程身份使用数据集。

tools.description: 通过管理端异步停止本项目任务；随后轮询状态确认节点清理。
tools.name: stop_execution

tools.description: 使用与控制台相同的管理端队列提交任务。仅当已发布脚本的 requires_project_environment 明确为 false 时可省略 environmentId，旧脚本及未完全绑定流程仍须提供；CSV脚本须提供 datasetSelections，支持copy/shard和每节点多个文件；timeoutSeconds 10至86400。脚本身份使用 pressurecooker.script_identities schema_version=1 声明，字段含name/type/secret/required；properties按script_identity.<身份名>.<声明字段>配置，最多20条身份；认证如何使用由脚本决定，旧Cookie身份脚本须显式转换并重新发布。身份名以字母开头，最多40个字母、数字、下划线或短横线。脚本选择身份，平台不自动轮询。全局属性合计最多100项，每值4096字符且身份字段为单行文本。任务固定环境快照；必须选择 clusterId，只使用所选集群控制器；省略 workers 时由服务端固定该集群全部关联节点，各节点执行完整 JMX，必须提供稳定幂等标识并在重试时复用参数。

tools.name: write_pressure_report_jvm

tools.description: 批量写入本项目READY报告的JVM监控，适用于上百实例。一次1至200条entries，组件固定jvm；每批只新增一个监控revision，全批校验和保存原子完成，保留其他实例及中间件。同请求重试复用原revision/idempotencyKey/参数。单批4MiB、60000总点，快照最多1000实例/8MiB；返回写入摘要，不回传全部时序。
tools.name: write_pressure_report_jvm_batch

tools.description: 向本项目READY报告写入ES/MySQL/Redis/Kafka外部监控指标、趋势、发现和来源。须携带当前监控revision（首次0）与稳定idempotencyKey；仅替换相同component+instance并保留补充历史，不修改JTL指标或启动采集/压测。时间范围须与压测重叠。
tools.name: write_pressure_report_middleware
